summary: Pins the compression library embedded in the plugin installer and manager's Cosign binary to the patched release.
userImpact: Plugin acquisition and signature verification retain their existing interfaces.

instructions: Use the rebuilt, signed plugin installer and manager images after their release qualifies; existing published image digests remain unchanged.

security: Pins github.com/klauspost/compress to v1.18.7 in both Cosign builds to address CVE-2026-63209 (GHSA-259r-337f-4rfw).
Build-time binary inspection requires the patched module version. Vulnerability severity and ignore policies remain unchanged.
documentation: Both plugin container third-party notices identify the patched Cosign dependency.
knownLimitations: An existing signed distribution lock cannot be silently retargeted to rebuilt toolchain images; a new signed release composition is required.
rollback: Restoring earlier toolchain images reintroduces the vulnerable dependency; prefer a forward fix.
validation: Installer and manager suites: 88 tests passed; both package type checks passed.
Helm security, rendering and compatibility checks passed; package/chart version bindings, release-note validation and documentation boundary checks passed.

Both local rebuilt images passed the unchanged HIGH/CRITICAL Trivy gate on linux/amd64 and linux/arm64, using the pinned scanner and 2026-10-21 vulnerability database. Patched Cosign verified the existing signed release candidate from non-root read-only containers; the manager package import smoke passed.
Protected CI and the new exact-source release candidate remain required before publication; no patched artifact is published by these local checks.
